05 · One channel or two

Your question: keep one Elavon channel with a Costco member playlist. Elavon holds 0 of the top 10 YouTube results for “Costco merchant services” today.

You asked whether to keep everything on the corporate channel with Costco-focused videos or start a Costco channel. The YouTube data does not decide this alone; your approval path and Costco’s co-branding rules matter as much. Here is what we found, and what each choice gets you.

What we found on YouTube and in AI answers

  • Costco’s channel leads the program search. On “Costco merchant services”, Costco’s own channel holds results one and seven, both about Elavon, and creator reviews of Elavon hold three more. Elavon’s channel holds none. A channel named “Costco Payment Processing” holds result five with a 2018 video; we could not confirm who runs it.
  • The gap is the owner’s first questions. In the top 10 YouTube results for 28 small-business searches (280 results), Elavon’s channel appears 0 times.
  • Your audience is small either way. 112 videos, 1,530 subscribers and a median of 90 views per video. A second channel would split that audience and add a second approval path.
  • Outside Costco it is the same. Across 10 questions on hotels, airlines, healthcare, software partners, public sector and retail, AI picks Elavon in 0 of 171 answers.
  • Your program site’s videos are not on YouTube. They play from another video host, so they cannot appear in YouTube results.

Done before

For a global digital infrastructure company, we merged scattered regional channels into one global channel organized around buyer questions.

One channel, Costco playlistA separate Costco channel
Starting audienceThe 1,530 subscribers and 112 videos you already haveStarts over, unless the 2018 Costco Payment Processing channel is yours to revive
Who it servesCostco members and every other Elavon channelCostco members only
A link to shareThe playlist link, for the program site and member emailsThe channel link
ReportingPlaylist reports in YouTube Analytics, plus UTM links per videoChannel reports
UpkeepOne channel and one approval pathA second channel to brand, approve and moderate
When it winsWhen you want one audience, one approval path and one name for AI to recognizeIf Costco needs its own co-branded channel, or your team cannot publish to the corporate one

Either way: Costco’s own channel already ranks first for the program search. Program videos placed there, with Costco’s agreement, reach members where they already look.

Putting a dollar figure on it: we need two numbers from you, what a new merchant is worth in a year and how many enrollments come through the program today. With those, the return is sized on your numbers, not ours. YouTube figures from the YouTube Data API and YouTube search, November 9, 2026.

How we measured. 34 questions written as small-business owners, Costco business members and enterprise buyers choosing a card processor would ask them (30 about the category, 4 naming Elavon), across seven needs and six stages: the problem, the solution, the price, the choice of processor, switching and trust in a processor. Six engines: ChatGPT (gpt-6-sol), Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Gemini 3.8 Flash answering from memory; Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode and Perplexity (Sonar) searching live. Each question asked up to three times per engine; 592 answers collected November 9, 2026. Also in this read (Costco program questions): 21 questions, 360 answers collected November 9, 2026. Also in this read (Corporate market questions): 15 questions, 259 answers collected November 9, 2026. A separate AI reader (Claude Sonnet 4.5, temperature 0, fixed rubric) recorded the processor each answer puts forward as its pick and the reason given; Elavon counts as recommended only when it is that pick, the same rule as for every other processor. Ranges are approximate 95% intervals; repeat asks of one question are not fully independent, so real uncertainty is wider. Public answers only; no Elavon internal data. One read is a Day-0 baseline, not a trend. Three question sets: small-business questions without Costco, Costco program questions, and questions from Elavon’s corporate markets. costcopaymentprocessing.com, which Elavon operates, counts as an Elavon site. Program terms were checked against the Costco FAQ.
